outlook.statement: During 2026-27, Q1 results showed considerable recovery in demand and business results and remaining quarters also expected to show further progressive recovery of demand and underlying business results.

Company will continue to leverage traditional trade distribution, launch premium LED range, new category segments like BLDC ceiling fans and expand distribution into electrical channel to grow aggressively in the LED category.
Channel expansion in Institutional and Digital business has led to 16% growth and all company activations are routed to sustain profitable growth in coming years.
Planned to increase distribution of range of new rechargeable torches at various consumer price points to solidify portfolio in this segment.

To continue indigenisation efforts and to further strengthen R&D activities for the purpose of cost reduction and quality improvements and for developing new products depending on market requirements.
Continuous efforts are being made to procure export orders.
Strengthen urban distribution and expand into modern trade and e-commerce platforms for batteries; alkaline segment growing at 50% with Nippo Thor and Nippo ThorMax launches.

Continue focus on LED across India through distribution expansion, channel management, and new product introductions like Spotlight & Fixtures; invest in new product offerings and focused distribution for mosquito swatters and repellents to drive growth in home-care segment; address rechargeable torches at economical price points with new RC launches.
The company does not forsee any requirement for long term funding in the near future.
